what_worked: Coherent topography metaphor sustained across slides with a clear chaos-to-prescription arc.
fix_next: Replace every illustrative schematic with real data charts showing actual values, axes, n-counts, and dataset-grounded evidence.
verdict: Polished consulting theater with no real data; illustrations masquerade as analysis.
factual_error_detail: Slide 1/title: frames dataset as 'SaaS Market' when it covers AI, Marketing, E-comm, Education, etc. Slide 7: table dimensions (product velocity, churn rate, pricing power) do not exist in the dataset—entirely fabricated. Slide 5: claims about Domain Rating vs X Followers as archetype drivers are asserted without any supporting correlation or data. Slide 3: quadrant scatter presented as data-derived but has no axis values, thresholds, or sample sizes—appears wholly illustrative.

evidence.insight: Core thesis (social attention → domain authority → MRR) is a plausible strategic idea but never substantiated with a single number from the dataset. No category, provider, TLD, or revenue analysis appears anywhere.
evidence.narrative: Arc is purposeful: chaos → framework → archetypes → drivers → anomalies → prescriptions → conclusion. Topography metaphor holds. But the narrative is built entirely on assertions, making it a story about a story rather than a data story.
evidence.framing: Title says 'SaaS Market' but dataset spans all categories. No mention of 1,000 rows, 216 zero-revenue entries, or 24–29% missingness across key fields. No audience specified. Scope and limitations entirely absent.
evidence.accuracy: Not a single verifiable figure from the frozen reference appears. Slide 6 cites 'Stealth Co 17, 718% growth' and slide 8 cites '12,983% MRR growth jump'—specific but unverifiable. Slide 7's four dimensions are fabricated columns not in the dataset. Zero revenue totals, medians, category counts, or provider shares shown.
evidence.visual: Illustrations are stylistically consistent and polished (NotebookLM-generated). However, every 'chart' (slides 3, 6, 8, 9) is a schematic illustration, not a data visualization—no real axes, values, or labels. This is decorative design, not evidence-led design. Downgraded from preliminary for decorative/fabricated charts.
evidence.ai_slop: Pervasive: 'operational velocity,' 'structural authority,' 'weaponise capital,' 'forensic audit of churn drivers,' 'existential timer,' 'fleeting social noise → permanent structural authority.' Slide 7 is generic SaaS consulting boilerplate. Every illustration is AI-generated decoration.

change_reason: Lowered framing by 0.5 (scope mislabeled, zero limitations) and visual by 0.5 (all charts are decorative schematics, not data visualizations—penalized per rubric for fabricated/decorative charts). Other scores confirmed as appropriate.
